description: Did you know you can control some TV's without the remote? Many modern TVs and other home electronics devices expose services to the local network via UPnP (Universal Plug and Play) to allow for basic management of things such as brightness, contrast and volume. So long as your TV supports certain UPnP services and is on your home network, with this app... you can control these values from your phone!
